text.description_html:
Von Duprin 9927 Grade 1 Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device

Von Duprin Series 99 Surface Vertical Rod exit and fire devices feature modern touchbar styling for heavy traffic applications. Designed for use on flush and wide stile doors, and fits 86 and 161 stock hollow metal cutouts.

The Von Duprin Series 99 Surface Vertical Rod are UL listed Panic Hardware (FVSR) SA163 (N). Fire devices (F) are UL listed Fire Exit Hardware (GXHX) R4504 (N), A label. Tested in accordance to ANSI A156.3, 1989, Grade 1.

Includes mounting hardware for both wood and metal doors. Sex Bolts furnished for top & bottom latches.

Features and Specifications: for Von Duprin 9927 Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device

  • Backset: 2 3/4"
  • Latches: Deadlocking Anti-friction Top & Bottom Bolt, 5/8" (16mm) throw
  • Mechanism Case Dimensions: 2-1/4" x 2-1/4" (57mm x 57mm)
  • Projection Pushbar: 3-13/16" (97 mm)
  • Vertical Rods: 1/2" square tubing
  • Top Rod Length: 34-15/16" (887mm)
  • Bottom Rod Length: 31-1/4" (794mm)
  • Stile: 4 1/2" minimum
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Hieght: 7' standard
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" - 2/14"
  • Door Width: 36", can be field sized to 30"
  • Dogging: 1/2" turn hex key non-fired rated device
  • Fire Rating: Available Option
  • Grade 1
